_note: The mandated Seedance prompt structure. Every line template here appears verbatim in lib/director.md under SEEDANCE PROMPT STRUCTURE. The engine had no copy of this, which meant nothing could check the header at all - and the header is where every reference is defined.
order: NO MUSIC, only natural ambient sounds.
No texts or subtitles on screen.

templates.character: • [Character name] face and outfit 100% matched based exactly on @
templates.screen: [Screen name] display content 100% matched based exactly on @
templates.tone: Visual tone: [paste the selected tone string verbatim from lib/tones.json]
templates.feel: Camera feel: [Handheld Shaky Camera or Static Shot - exact library string]
templates.no_music: NO MUSIC, only natural ambient sounds.
templates.no_subtitles: No texts or subtitles on screen.

shot_line: [X-Ys] - [A-ROLL or B-ROLL if applicable]. [Camera shot size / angle - exact library prompt]. [Camera movement - exact library prompt, if any]. [Action description with name @ for every reference visible in this shot]. [Character name] @ [says/mutters/yells/whispers etc] out loud: "[dialogue]"

conditional.object: only if it appears in this clip
conditional.screen: only if a screen appears in this clip
conditional.scene: only if a location image exists - otherwise REPLACE this line with a short written setting description. Never both.
conditional.aroll_broll_label: only when the operator has confirmed B-roll. Omit for pure narrative or scripted fiction.

screen_shot_lines.with_reference: [Screen device] screen displaying the [Screen name] @ as defined in the header, visible and legible on screen
screen_shot_lines.green_screen_placeholder: solid bright green screen placeholder with a white cross in each of the four corners and one white cross in the center of the display, clearly visible and legible on screen
screen_shot_lines._crosses: Five white crosses total: four corners, one center. Mandatory every single time a green screen placeholder is used. Never omit them.

at_rule.header: Every reference is defined in the header with its label BEFORE the @, and the @ itself is completely blank. Nothing after it, ever.
at_rule.shots: Visible in the shot = name @. Not visible in the shot (mentioned in dialogue, or an off-screen voice) = name only, no @.

never: Never describe a character physically in a Seedance prompt. No skin tone, no hair colour, no outfit details. The @ does all the work.
Include only what actually appears in THIS clip. A character who does not appear must not be in this clip's header.
A character who appears even briefly in the background still must be in the header.
Never write dialogue as a voiceover, and never label it 'DIALOGUE:'. Write it as a character action: 'Sarah @ mutters to herself:'
Repeat any special costume or appearance rules in every single prompt without exception.
